name: Mortality Wanes
summary: Heralath Fallowbrook lies dying in Razorfen Kraul, with one last plea for the living. He asks that his wife's stolen pendant reach Darnassus, along with word of his death.

sections.title: A Dying Breath in the Thorns
sections.body: In Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook lies mortally wounded among the brambles. The stronghold is overrun by savage quilboar and dark magic, far from Alliance territory. With his strength fading, Heralath manages only broken whispers. He says a brave dwarf named Lonebrow was sent ahead to warn Falfindel. Heralath knows he will not leave the Kraul alive.

sections.title: The Pendant of Bonding
sections.body: Heralath's last wish is to recover the pendant that marks his marriage to Treshala Fallowbrook. One of the lair's aggressors tore it from him. He asks any traveler who stops beside him to carry it across Kalimdor to Darnassus, so Treshala learns of his death instead of waiting in vain.

sections.title: Grief in Darnassus
sections.body: Treshala Fallowbrook receives her husband's recovered pendant in Darnassus and learns that he has died. Devastated, she vows that Heralath's work will not perish with him. She is left to mourn alone and carry his legacy through her sudden grief.

faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook is an Alliance night elf found mortally wounded in Razorfen Kraul. As his strength fades, he entrusts passing travelers with recovering his wife's stolen pendant of bonding and taking word of his death to Darnassus.
Heralath Fallowbrook lies inside Razorfen Kraul, the thorn-choked quilboar stronghold in the southern Barrens.
Lonebrow is a brave dwarf Heralath mentions in his final moments. Heralath says Lonebrow was sent out of the briars to warn Falfindel about the dangers in the Kraul.
Treshala Fallowbrook is Heralath's wife and lives in Darnassus. She receives the recovered pendant and learns of her husband's death.

faq.q: What is the pendant of bonding?
faq.answer: The pendant of bonding is a keepsake that signifies the marriage of Heralath and Treshala Fallowbrook. Quilboar aggressors stole it from Heralath before he died in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: How does Treshala react to the news?
aliases: what happens when you deliver the pendant
faq.answer: Treshala is heartbroken and laments the world's cruelty. In her grief, she resolves that Heralath's work must continue through her, then asks to be left alone to mourn.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion in the Horde-dominated Barrens, you carry Heralath's final token home to Darnassus as a somber duty of honor.
As a night elf, you feel the sting of seeing one of your kin perish alone and forgotten in the southern Barrens.
As a dwarf, you hear Heralath honor Lonebrow's bravery in carrying an urgent warning away from the quilboar stronghold.
